conflict_resolution_policy.policy_decision: All 161 assessment rows are preserved in `all_records` with audit indicators (`is_repeated_candidate`, `has_target_conflict`). For robust machine learning, `clean_unambiguous_records` (145 records) excludes the 7 conflicting candidates whose outcome changed between assessment sittings. `latest_attempt_records` (152 records) preserves the latest assessment for each candidate.
